title: Spot the Flaw: Governance & Contracts Edition
brief: This customer-360 model is heading to production behind a data contract. It is structurally sound, but a governance review flagged four gaps that would ship a weak contract: a Tier-1 critical asset with no freshness SLA, an unclassified PII column, a misnamed dimension, and that same dimension left undocumented. Fix all four in-app, then re-validate to see the contract go clean.

expected_flaws.hint: A Tier-1 critical asset with no freshness guarantee makes a hollow contract. Which asset promises freshness but declares none?
expected_flaws.fix: Open fact_orders' entity settings and declare a freshness SLA, e.g. '< 1h'.

expected_flaws.hint: The contract must declare which columns carry personal data. One column looks like PII but isn't classified.
expected_flaws.fix: Select dim_customer.email and tick 'Contains PII' (pii_type EMAIL) so the contract governs it.

expected_flaws.hint: A DIMENSION should announce itself by its name. One dimension is missing its type prefix.
expected_flaws.fix: Open the 'marketing' entity settings and rename it 'dim_marketing' in the Name field.

expected_flaws.hint: A consumer can't sign a contract against an undocumented asset. Which dimension has no description?
expected_flaws.fix: In the same entity's settings, write a description.

solution_notes: The contract-ready model declares a freshness SLA on the Tier-1 fact_orders asset, classifies dim_customer.email as PII (EMAIL), renames the 'marketing' dimension to 'dim_marketing' (restoring the type prefix), and documents it. All four fixes are made with the in-app editors — Entity Settings for the SLA, rename, and description; the column editor's 'Contains PII' toggle for the classification. Renaming cascades to the fact_orders.campaign_sk foreign-key relationship automatically. After the fixes, re-validation shows no MISSING_SLA, PII_EXPOSURE, NAMING_CONVENTION, or MISSING_DESCRIPTION issues, and the exported OpenDataContract/dbt artifacts carry the tier, slaProperties, and PII metadata.
